statement: Build a one-page website for Brew Lab, a cafe on 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, that shows today's hours, the menu with prices, a pre-order form with a running rupee total sent by WhatsApp, a loyalty stamp card and directions, and works on a 360px phone screen.
audience: Customers in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru, mostly on phones, who want to check if the cafe is open, see prices, pre-order for pickup and find the way there.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Works at 360px and 1280px wide with no horizontal overflow
No JavaScript errors on load or on use
rules: Use only the hours, menu, prices, address, map link and WhatsApp number the Requester supplied
Pre-orders go to WhatsApp +91 98450 00000; payment is at pickup; pickup is within 15 minutes of ordering
The pre-order form uses the same six menu items and prices as the menu section
done_when: The hours section lists Monday to Friday 8am to 10pm and Saturday and Sunday 9am to 11pm, and JavaScript highlights today's row automatically from the visitor's current day.
The menu shows every item with a ₹ price: Coffee: Espresso 120, Cappuccino 180, Pour-over 220; Cold: Cold brew 200; Food: Croissant 150, Banana bread 130.
The pre-order form lists the same six items with quantity inputs and shows a running total in ₹ that updates as quantities change.
Submitting the pre-order form opens a WhatsApp message to +91 98450 00000 containing the chosen items and the total, and the page states pay at pickup and pickup within 15 minutes of ordering.
The loyalty section shows 10 stamp circles, with the 10th circle marked FREE.
The location section shows the address 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 and a "Get directions" link to https://maps.google.com/?q=100+Feet+Road+Indiranagar+Bengaluru+560038.
At 360px and 1280px wide the page has no horizontal overflow, and loading and using the page throws no JavaScript errors.
